findings.one_line: The proposed deliverable was a complete EXT-ID decision procedure returning a same-input separating pair on every failure, whereas the achieved procedure still returns bare FAIL and proves only success soundness/termination; position the scoped transfer as the new headline rather than the promised completeness object.

RF is called a computable finite semialgebraic certificate, but its 'fixed nonrestrictive' disturbance cardinalities are neither bounded nor specified from the graph and state spaces, so a reader cannot instantiate the claimed finite disjunction; state an explicit bound or enumeration algorithm and dimensions.

The theorem asserts an arbitrary-selection-ADMG edge-silent lift, while the TL;DR, technical limitation, and honest scope say the graph-level transfer applies only to terminal unconfounded selection; reconcile the headline, scope statements, and closest-prior comparison so the actual claimed advance is unambiguous.

This unconsumed numbered proposition is comparative positioning rather than a delivered causal result; delete it as a core node and retain the relevant Qiu scope comparison (including the scalar-versus-table point) as related-work prose.
